qolFindings.title: Contained destination labels break within words at 320 px with 200% text
qolFindings.evidence: Current fux-r4 selected-person captures show 'Nuovo equipaggio' breaking within its words and 'Mezzi' wrapping as 'Mez/zi'. The spans at CrewManagement.tsx:3095, :3107 and :3118 use overflow-wrap:anywhere. Horizontal label bounds and enabled action hit tests pass.
qolFindings.reproduction: Open a selected student or volunteer destination panel at 320x664 with 200% root text. Scroll the panel to inspect the direct destination actions. Labels remain contained and actions remain reachable, but their narrow columns reduce legibility.
